name: What are common problems to avoid during porcelain tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What are common problems to avoid during porcelain tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several common problems can arise during porcelain tile installation if not handled by experienced professionals. These include inadequate subfloor preparation leading to uneven surfaces or cracks, incorrect mortar mixing or application causing poor adhesion, and improper grouting techniques resulting in uneven lines or future cracking. Other issues involve poor tile layout, which can lead to excessive waste or an aesthetically unpleasing finish, and insufficient curing time. Ensuring proper expansion joints are left is also crucial to prevent buckling. Hiring an experienced contractor like City Dweller, LLC helps mitigate these risks, ensuring a high-quality and durable installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid inadequate subfloor prep, incorrect mortar, improper grouting, poor layout, and insufficient curing time.
